findings.description: F-022: tablo.goto(0, 260) places the scoreboard inside the legal playfield (|y| <= 280), so the snake can overwrite it. snake.py fixes this with a HUD band and 19.32's checklist lists it as a finished-app criterion, but 19.5 never told the reader the prototype violates it.
findings.resolution: Added an info callout to build_05 stating that y = 260 is a legal cell, that the snake can drive through the text, and that 19.32 moves the scoreboard into a separate HUD band above the field. Prototype code deliberately left unchanged — the simplification is fine once disclosed.
